items.title: Oracle Issues Emergency Java Update for Critical 9.1 HTTPS Trust Vulnerability
items.description: Oracle has released an emergency Java security update to address CVE-2026-91403, a critical vulnerability affecting how Java applications trust digital certificates. Published on October 21, 2026, the alert assigns the flaw a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.1 and covers Oracle Java SE and GraalVM. items.description: The Everest ransomware group claims to have stolen 590.69 GB of data from PwC, the global professional services firm. items.title: The AI Agent Nobody Owns: Watch Expert Webinar On Your Newest Insider Threat
items.description: Right now, there is probably an AI agent running on a laptop somewhere in your network. It stores API keys and database passwords, can access your internal systems, and works without anyone watching. Nobody reviewed its access. Nobody owns it. If an employee had that much reach with that little oversight, you would call it an insider risk. So why do we still call the agent a productivity tool?
